title: JSON Formatter & Beautifier
description: Format, beautify, and validate JSON data online. Free, fast, and privacy-friendly — no data sent to servers.

faq.a: JSON Formatter is a free online tool that formats, beautifies, and validates JSON data. It makes raw JSON data human-readable with proper indentation and syntax highlighting.
Yes. All formatting happens entirely in your browser. No data is sent to any server.
Yes, completely free with no usage limits.
